article.story: HONOLULU -- — Scotty Washington scored 24 points to lead Cal State Northridge to an 83-60 victory over Hawaii on Thursday night. Washington made 9 of 15 shots with three 3-pointers for the Matadors (12-6, 4-3 Big West Conference). Marcus Adams Jr. had 18 points and Keonte Jones added 12 points and 12 rebounds. PJ Fuller II scored 14. Aaron Hunkin-Claytor scored 10 off the bench to lead the Rainbow Warriors (11-6, 3-3). Tom Beattie added nine points. -------- Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
